newsitem.title: USA: Hasbro plans to close plants in England.
newsitem.headline: Hasbro plans to close plants in England.

text.p: Hasbro Inc., the No. 2 maker of of toys and games, said Friday it plans to shut its Waddington Games manufacturing facilities in Castle Gate and Paddock, England at the beginning of June.
Together, the facilities employ approximately 250 people.
Production will move to the company's plants in Waterford, Ireland and Valencia, Spain.
"After much deliberation and a careful analysis of our European manufacturing capacity, we reached this difficult but necessary decision," said Bryan Ellis, managing director of Hasbro UK.
"The competitive nature of the toy business demands that we constantly fine-tune the production load in our various plants in Europe."
Hasbro stock was up 25 cents at $43.375 in morning trading on the American Stock Exchange.
